title: Specification for emitted negations
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a_1,\ldots,a_k$ be a list of vertex indices, let $G$ be a list of gates, and let $(G',v_1,\ldots,v_m)$ denote a pair consisting of a gate list and a list of vertex indices. The specification requires that $G'$ extend $G$ by appending gates, be acyclic, and have length $|G|+k$; the index list has length $k$, contains distinct vertices, and each of its entries is at least $n+|G|$ and less than $n+|G'|$. For every Boolean assignment to the $n$ input vertices, the values at these indices are the negations of the values at $a_1,\ldots,a_k$, respectively; each such vertex has depth at most one plus the maximum depth among those listed vertices, and every appended gate is well formed and is a NOT gate.
hypotheses_covered: Output pair of gate list and vertex list
Output gates extend the initial gates
Output gate-list length is initial length plus input-list length
Output vertex-list length equals input-list length
Every output vertex index is less than $n$ plus output gate-list length
Every output vertex index is at least $n$ plus initial gate-list length
For every Boolean input assignment, output values are the negations of the corresponding input-vertex values
Each output vertex depth is at most one plus the maximum input-vertex depth
Every appended gate is well formed and a NOT gate
